title: Reviewer guesses observation wrapper and dimension evidence record fields
review_basis: Full new136 native reviewer history inspected; original136 viewed. Existing schema lookup only exposes PageContent/Review, while source-observation has sibling quote arguments and dimension records have a different model. Retained selected first failed file-tool calls have actual schema errors. Review ultimately PASS, but delivery shape caused avoidable retries.
failure_oracle: Expose exact observation wrapper and DimensionReview schema/example before writes; keep source blindness, actual crop/tips, independent indices and strict PASS. Example coordinates/placeholders are never source evidence. No claimed model speed/accuracy gain without production evidence.
